title: Augustana Faculty, Visiting Artists to Showcase Work at Eide/Dalrymple Gallery
summary_en: TheEide/Dalrymple Galleryat Augustana is showcasing recent works by university art instructors and faculty, as well as visiting artists for “The Augustana Faculty Biennial." The exhibit will be on view from Thursday, Nov. 5, through Saturday, Dec. 5. A gallery reception will take place from 7-9 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 6, with a gallery talk at 7:30 p.m.
